title: Sanskrit–Vedic Language Knowledge Layer
purpose: Character recognition, preservation of Vedic orthography, candidate lexical lookup, and safe preparation of text for the existing Android/Chrome Speech Synthesis voice.
coverageNotice: This file is a structured starter knowledge layer, not an exhaustive lexicon of every word in all four Vedas, Brahmanas, Aranyakas, Upanishads, Puranas, or every recension. Entries without source references are lookup candidates, not verified definitions or source attestations.

enginePolicy.voiceSelectionPolicy: Preserve the application voice already tested by the user; do not replace it from this data file.
enginePolicy.ttsTextPolicy: Pass the original text unchanged by default. Do not strip Vedic marks or rewrite words unless a rule has been independently tested and explicitly enabled.

characterInventory.note: Traditional inventory and extended Unicode characters are kept separate. Extended characters can occur in editions or mixed-script texts but are not all ordinary Sanskrit phonemes.

vedicExtensions.policy: Preserve exact code points; consult the source tradition for interpretation.

devanagariExtended.policy: Includes signs used in specialized Vedic/Sama Veda and editorial contexts; not every sign is a pronunciation mark.

conjunctPatterns.note: Patterns are recognition aids, not a complete enumeration of all valid conjuncts.

textProcessingPolicy.unknownCharacters: Preserve and report their code point; do not delete them.
textProcessingPolicy.unicodeNormalization: Do not rewrite the source string as a side effect of lookup. If a normalized search key is needed, retain both source and search key.
textProcessingPolicy.sourceVariants: Store variants as separate records and attach work, recension, edition, and location when known.
textProcessingPolicy.lexiconLookup: Lookup may annotate text but must not replace its visible spelling.

pronunciationPreparation.ruleActivation: Each normalization/pronunciation rule must have a test case and explicit opt-in before affecting TTS input.
pronunciationPreparation.warning: A dictionary lookup or successful character recognition does not prove a particular voice has produced a historically or shakha-specific pronunciation.

integrationContract.failureMode: If the JSON cannot be loaded, continue with the original text and existing TTS behavior; report the missing knowledge file without destroying playback.

preservationAssertions: Original display text remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
Existing voice selection and sequential onend-driven playback are unchanged.
testCases.expectedStatus: Tests must be run in the target Android/Chrome environment before marking runtime acceptance as PASS.

provenance.characterNameSource: Unicode character names are recorded from the Python runtime Unicode database for assigned code points in the specified ranges.
provenance.lexicalSource: Curated seed terms based on the conversation master block; individual entries are not yet attached to critical editions or exact verse/mantra references.
